name: Regular Council Meeting
agenda_text:
City of El Segundo Video Streaming
MEETING SUMMARY
CALL TO ORDER
INVOCATION
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
A. Proclamation announcing August 7 and 8, 2010, St. Anthony School Golden Jubilee Week.
B. Special Orders of Business
PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS
MEMORIALS
1. The introduction and first reading of an Ordinance approving Environmental Assessment EA No. 863 and Zone Text Amendment ZTA 10-03.
2. Public Hearing regarding a Resolution finding that the City conforms with the annual Congestion Management Program (CMP).
C. Unfinished Business
3. Call for a special election to place an initiative on the ballot to amend and increase City's utility user tax ("UUT") and transient occupancy tax ("TOT").
4. Consideration to transition the El Segundo Fire Department's ("ESFD") services to the Consolidated Fire Protection District of Los Angeles County (aka the Los Angeles County Fire Department).
E. Consent Agenda
5. Warrant Numbers 2578242 to 2578444 and Wire Transfers from 7/09/10 through 07/22/1.
6. Regular City Council Meeting Minutes of July 20, 2010.
7. Approve an Agreement with the City of Hawthorne to implement and maintain server-based Records Management System and related software applications developed by Tiburon Inc.
8. El Segundo Police Department's acceptance and expenditure of one-time grant funds from the California Office of Traffic Safety (OTS) "DUI Enforcement and Awareness Program."
9. Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) license for on-site sale and off-site consumption of alcohol at an existing convenient store located at 601 North Sepulveda Boulevard.
10. Adopt Ordinance No. 1444 approving Environmental Assessment EA 755 and Zone Text Amendment ZTA 07-02 to amend the El Segundo Municipal Code ("ESMC") off-street parking and loading regulations.
11. Request from Mattel, Inc. to allow two temporary five hundred four (504) square-foot "Special Event Signs".
12. Adopt a resolution setting a public hearing for Council consideration of a franchise agreement with Golden State Water Company.
F. NEW BUSINESS
REPORTS - CITY MANAGER
13. Consideration and possible action regarding Business License Tax Recommendation - (1) This item serves as a place holder. Currently meeting with businesses on this matter; (2) Alternatively, discuss and take other action related to this item.
PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS
ADJOURNMENT
